plugins.name: Top processos
plugins.description: Os processos que mais usam CPU ou memória, com tela e script próprios.
plugins.author: pedroluizmossi

plugins.name: Pulso
plugins.description: Monitor de batimentos da máquina: CPU, RAM, temperatura e rede ao vivo, recorde guardado, o processo culpado nos picos e o IP público.
plugins.author: pedroluizmossi

plugins.name: Repositories
plugins.description: Your Git repositories and what is left to commit and push, with one-click push and pull, the AI agent working in each one and the GitHub CI. The mascot nags about old pending work and celebrates when everything is pushed. Works on Linux and Windows (needs git; the CI needs gh).
plugins.author: pedroluizmossi

plugins.name: Code index
plugins.description: Watches your code-index server: how many repositories are indexed, pending or in error, the latest sync and the enrichment progress. Search the code from the cell, open a result in the editor and start the next sync batch after a confirmation.
plugins.author: pedroluizmossi
